scripts.build: node scripts/verify-editorial-content.mjs && node scripts/generate-discovery.mjs && tsc -b && vite build --config vite.config.ts && node scripts/prerender.mjs && node scripts/verify-dist.mjs && node scripts/verify-bilingual.mjs
scripts.test:legacy: node --input-type=module -e "import { readdirSync } from 'node:fs'; import { spawnSync } from 'node:child_process'; const files=readdirSync('tests').filter((file)=>file.endsWith('.test.mjs')&&!file.includes('.vitest.test.')).map((file)=>'tests/'+file); const result=spawnSync(process.execPath,['--test',...files],{stdio:'inherit'}); process.exit(result.status??1)"
scripts.test: pnpm run test:legacy && pnpm run test:unit
